title: The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9

The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9

The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by 50 basis points or more, to 4.25%-4.50% or higher, at the meeting ending December 9, 2026. Governor Waller is the only official to back it publicly; New York Fed President Williams has ruled it out.
